attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"She traced the jagged scar on the sleeve—the mark Rook Malley had left on him a year ago.","severity":"minor","reason":"a scar on a tunic sleeve is an added detail about the past; the briefing says Malley maimed him, not a scar on clothing"},{"span":"his notched combat knife, the blade dulled from a thousand strikes","severity":"minor","reason":"invented detail about the dead man's past use of the knife; the knife is not in the briefing"},{"span":"where her father used to boast of his victories","severity":"minor","reason":"added habit of the dead man, not in the briefing"},{"span":"Her mother sat in the shadows, silent","severity":"minor","reason":"Lene is not named, but she is the mother in the briefing; placing her present is staging"}],"voice":3,"clarity":3,"tone":4,"overall":3,"comment":"Atmospheric and in keeping with the harsh setting, with a sensible ending on the scavenger's pack, but it never states what Tamsin means to do and has no real link to the revenge threat against Cinder Rest.
